messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — following the PM postmortem, we need to assign owners for the recurring cache-thrash pattern. I created tracker ticket RW-8765. Can folks pick owners and rough timelines? cc @oncall-bot

Clare: I'll take infra/SRE side. Plan: 48h spike to reproduce locally, config PR next, then canary.

Kevin: I can own app-side fixes and verification. I'll open RW-8766 and link to RW-8765.

Anna: I'll be A for rollout + stakeholder comms. RACI proposal: R=Clare/Kevin, A=Anna, C=EngOps, I=Support.

Morgan: Proposed milestones: spike=48h, PRs in 7d, canary in 14d, full rollout in 21d. Speak up if unrealistic.

Kevin: ack. Creating RW-8766 now. Assigning to @Kevin, ETA for PR: 2026-04-10.

Clare: RW-8765 assigned to @Clare. ETA for spike: 2026-04-08. Adding notes about cache warmup and KV eviction tests.

Matt: Noting recurring pattern — Fridays show spike in miss rate when leader elections happen. Add to RCA backlog.

oncall-bot: reminder: next oncall rotation starts 1954400000 — please update handoff notes.

Morgan: Action checklist (quick):
```
- RW-8765 (infra spike) -> Clare
- RW-8766 (app fix + runbook) -> Kevin
- RW-8770 (alert tuning) -> Sarah
- Stakeholder comms -> Anna
- Update postmortem doc -> Morgan
```

Clare: Ping for handoff — Kevin, once infra PR merges can you run the deploy verification steps in the runbook? If not, we'll schedule a handoff.

Kevin: I will own deploy verification + add a post-deploy smoke script in RW-8766.

Sarah: I'll add alert tuning ticket RW-8770 and propose thresholds. Will include dashboards and runbook snippet.

Anna: I'll draft the customer-impact note and internal summary after canary. Target send date: after successful canary.

Morgan: Thanks all. I'll update the remediation table in the postmortem with owners, Jira links, and timelines. Follow-up sync next Thursday @10am to close the loop. :thumbsup:
